name: Threefold Sanctuary
summary: Three generous prayer portals are carved from a single low, sweeping mosque vault.
why: The main vault and central doorway share x54. Side portals mirror at x36 and 72, and all three open on y74. A colored roof plane remains wholly within the unified architecture.
risk: Without a separate minaret the mosque is more abstract. The pointed vault and three prayer arches carry its Islamic identity.
sub1: A centered arch with two mirrored side openings
sub2: A low, unified mosque without detached towers
reasonToChoose: You want a compact mosque built around generous space and one sweeping silhouette.
